metadata.description: Governed gateway for Claude Code on Microsoft Foundry: per-developer token budgets, tiering, and chargeback, with no model credential on any developer machine.
Base name used to derive resource names. Must be globally unique for the API Management instance.
Location for all resources.
Name of the existing Microsoft Foundry (AIServices) account that hosts your Claude deployments.
Resource group of the Foundry account. Defaults to this resource group.
Publisher email shown on the API Management instance.
Publisher name shown on the API Management instance.
API Management SKU. Anthropic Messages API token parsing requires a v2 tier; classic tiers count zero tokens and budgets never trigger.
API Management scale units.
Keep the gateway's VNet mode. External with a Microsoft.Web/serverFarms subnet is outbound integration (Standard v2, Premium v2).
Subnet for apimVirtualNetworkType. Empty when None.
Protocol and cipher settings the gateway already has. Empty for a new gateway.
Hostname bindings read from a template-owned gateway before redeployment. Unrelated bindings and their certificates are retained.
Deployment name of the Sonnet-class model in Foundry.
Deployment name of the Opus-class model in Foundry.
Deployment used for the haiku alias and background tasks. Point at your Sonnet deployment if you have no Haiku deployment.
Standard tier: tokens per minute, per developer.
Standard tier: tokens per day, per developer.
Premium tier: tokens per minute, per developer.
Premium tier: tokens per day, per developer.

Organisation-wide ceiling: total tokens per month across every developer. This is a soft cap - the llm-token-limit policy allows high-concurrency requests to temporarily exceed it, so it bounds spend rather than guaranteeing it. The default is roughly one premium developer's month, which fails safe: raise it deliberately before a wider rollout.

Models the standard tier may call, comma-delimited with sentinel commas (",claude-sonnet-5,"). Empty means every deployed model. Enforced at the gateway, before the request reaches Foundry, so it cannot be bypassed by editing a client.
As modelsStandard, for the premium tier.

Business unit registry to preserve, in sentinel form (",id=Group:tokens,"). Set-ClaudeBusinessUnit.ps1 owns this after the first deployment, so Install-ClaudeGateway.ps1 reads it off the gateway and hands it back rather than resetting it.
Business unit membership to preserve, in sentinel form (",oid=id,"). Sync-ClaudeAccess.ps1 owns this after the first deployment.

Business unit parent map to preserve, in sentinel form (",team=parent,"). A unit that names a parent is a team, and a request is charged to the team and to its parent. Set-ClaudeBusinessUnit.ps1 owns this after the first deployment.
Budget enforcement exceptions to preserve: ",sales=allowance:10,sales-emea=notify,". Absent units are strict; ",," keeps every budget strict.
Preserve dated USD budgets (base64 JSON). Empty leaves the optional USD control disabled.
Preserve the USD reconciler snapshot (base64 JSON), including stops and its freshness deadline.

What happens to a developer who belongs to no business unit. "allow" serves them and records the usage against no budget; "deny" refuses. The default is allow because no developer has a business unit at the moment this first deploys, and deny would refuse every request. Move to deny once assignment is complete - Get-ClaudeBusinessUnit.ps1 reports how many are unassigned.
Request-rate ceiling per developer per minute. Stops a runaway agent loop that makes many small calls.
Where the gateway reads entitlement from. Leave on named-value until a projection exists and the shadow comparison reports no drift - see docs/adr/0013-gateway-outlives-instance.md.

Base URL of the entitlement resolver. Only read when entitlementSource is projection. The placeholder is deliberate - an empty named value is awkward to reason about, and this one is obviously unset if it ever appears in a trace.

Entra audience the gateway asks for a managed identity token against, when calling the resolver. Separate from the URL on purpose: the two often differ, and conflating them produces a token the resolver rejects.
Optional extra Entra audience accepted from external-idp sign-in. Empty keeps the shipped Azure CLI/helper-script audiences only.

How long the gateway may serve an identity the directory has already changed, in seconds. This is the staleness bound, and it also sets the resolver cost, because cost follows cache misses rather than requests.
Object ids allowed at the standard tier. Normally left empty and populated by Sync-ClaudeAccess.ps1 from an Entra group.
Object ids allowed at the premium tier.

Grant the gateway identity Cognitive Services User on the Foundry account. Set false when an equivalent assignment already exists - Azure rejects a second assignment for the same principal, role and scope even under a different name, which is what a reused gateway hits.
Create an Azure AI Content Safety account and grant APIM access. Existing deployments keep this false unless an operator opts in.
Content Safety policy mode. Existing deployments default to off; opt-in installers pass block unless the operator chooses audit.
Existing Content Safety endpoint. Empty uses the account created by this deployment.
Content Safety harm threshold for FourSeverityLevels severities.
Seconds APIM waits for each Content Safety call.
Content Safety public network access for the optional account.
Existing allow list to preserve, in sentinel form (",oid1,oid2,"). Install-ClaudeGateway.ps1 reads this off the gateway before redeploying. Empty means derive from allowStandardOids.
As allowStandardValueExisting, for the premium tier.

Existing per-user daily quota overrides to preserve, in sentinel form (",oid=tokens,"). Install-ClaudeGateway.ps1 reads this off the gateway before redeploying so overrides set by Set-ClaudeBudget.ps1 survive. Empty means no overrides.
Name of an existing API Management instance to reuse. It must be a v2 SKU and must live in this resource group. Leave empty to create one named apim-{namePrefix}.

<!--
  Claude Code on Microsoft Foundry - governed gateway policy (tiered).

  Identity
  ========
  Claude Code's Foundry mode acquires the developer's own Entra ID token through
  DefaultAzureCredential, so every request carries a real, unforgeable user
  object id (oid). The gateway validates that token, decides the caller's tier,
  meters against the oid, then discards the token and calls Foundry with the
  gateway's own managed identity.

  Developers hold no Foundry credential. Removing a person from the Entra group
  removes their access; nothing has to be revoked on the endpoint itself.

  Authorization
  =============
  allow-standard / allow-premium are comma-delimited lists of object ids kept in
  sync from Entra groups by Sync-ClaudeAccess.ps1. Sentinel commas make the
  contains() check exact so one id cannot partially match another.
-->
<policies>
    <inbound>
        <base />

        <!-- 1. Authenticate the caller. The standard helper path requests a
             token for the Cognitive Services data plane. An external IdP can
             instead send a token for a public-client app (id_token) or an
             explicit gateway API audience (access_token). That extra audience
             is accepted only when the installer recorded it. -->
        <choose>
            <when condition="@(!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace("{{external-idp-extra-audience}}") && "{{external-idp-extra-audience}}" != "urn:disabled:claude-extra-audience")">
                <validate-azure-ad-token
                    tenant-id="{{tenant-id}}"
                    output-token-variable-name="jwt"
                    failed-validation-httpcode="401"
                    failed-validation-error-message="A Microsoft Entra ID token is required. Run 'az login'.">
                    <audiences>
                        <audience>https://cognitiveservices.azure.com</audience>
                        <audience>https://ai.azure.com</audience>
                        <audience>{{external-idp-extra-audience}}</audience>
                    </audiences>
                </validate-azure-ad-token>
            </when>
            <otherwise>
                <validate-azure-ad-token
                    tenant-id="{{tenant-id}}"
                    output-token-variable-name="jwt"
                    failed-validation-httpcode="401"
                    failed-validation-error-message="A Microsoft Entra ID token is required. Run 'az login'.">
                    <audiences>
                        <audience>https://cognitiveservices.azure.com</audience>
                        <audience>https://ai.azure.com</audience>
                    </audiences>
                </validate-azure-ad-token>
            </otherwise>
        </choose>

        <!-- 2. Identity from the validated token. -->
        <set-variable name="userId" value="@(((Jwt)context.Variables["jwt"]).Claims.GetValueOrDefault("oid", "unknown"))" />
        <set-variable name="userUpn" value="@{
            var jwt = (Jwt)context.Variables["jwt"];
            return jwt.Claims.GetValueOrDefault("upn",
                   jwt.Claims.GetValueOrDefault("unique_name",
                   jwt.Claims.GetValueOrDefault("preferred_username",
                   jwt.Claims.GetValueOrDefault("azp", "service-principal"))));
        }" />
        <set-variable name="sessionId" value="@(context.Request.Headers.GetValueOrDefault("x-claude-code-session-id", "none"))" />
        <set-variable name="modelName" value="@{
            try { return context.Request.Body.As<JObject>(preserveContent: true)["model"]?.ToString() ?? "unknown"; }
            catch { return "unknown"; }
        }" />
        <set-variable name="usdRequestStream" value="@{
            try { return (bool?)context.Request.Body.As<JObject>(preserveContent: true)["stream"] ?? false; }
            catch { return true; }
        }" />

        <!-- 2b. Where entitlement comes from.
             
             Both paths are here from this deployment onward, chosen by a named
             value, so moving a gateway that is already carrying traffic is a
             configuration change rather than a policy deployment. ADR-0013
             records why: a policy that grows the resolver path later has to be
             redeployed and re-verified against production traffic, on the day
             nobody wants to be changing it.
             
             entitlement-source is 'named-value' everywhere until an operator
             changes it, so this block resolves to nothing on every existing
             deployment and the list path below runs exactly as it always has. -->
        <set-variable name="entResolved" value="@(false)" />
        <set-variable name="entResolving" value="@(false)" />
        <choose>
            <when condition="@("{{entitlement-source}}" == "projection")">
                <choose>
                    <!-- Configured to use the projection with no resolver behind
                         it. This is a misconfiguration rather than an outage, and
                         it is worth its own message: the operator who flipped
                         entitlement-source is the only person who can fix it, and
                         a generic "unavailable" sends them looking at the wrong
                         thing. -->
                    <when condition="@("{{entitlement-resolver-url}}".Contains("resolver-not-deployed"))">
                        <return-response>
                            <set-status code="503" reason="Service Unavailable" />
                            <set-header name="Content-Type" exists-action="override">
                                <value>application/json</value>
                            </set-header>
                            <set-body>@{
                                return new JObject(
                                    new JProperty("type", "error"),
                                    new JProperty("error", new JObject(
                                        new JProperty("type", "api_error"),
                                        new JProperty("message",
                                            "This gateway is configured to read entitlement from the projection, but no " +
                                            "resolver is deployed. Set entitlement-resolver-url, or set entitlement-source " +
                                            "back to named-value. No developer access has changed.")))
                                ).ToString();
                            }</set-body>
                        </return-response>
                    </when>
                    <otherwise>
                        <!-- Marked so on-error can tell an entitlement failure
                             from any other, and answer 503 rather than 500.
                             send-request's ignore-error covers a transport
                             failure but not a managed-identity token failure,
                             which throws out of the whole block. -->
                        <set-variable name="entResolving" value="@(true)" />
                        <cache-lookup-value key="@("ent:v2:{{tenant-id}}:" + (string)context.Variables["userId"])" variable-name="entRecord" />
                        <choose>
                            <when condition="@(!context.Variables.ContainsKey("entRecord"))">
                                <rate-limit-by-key calls="200" renewal-period="1" counter-key="entitlement-misses" />
                                <limit-concurrency key="entitlement-misses" max-count="100">
                                <send-request mode="new" response-variable-name="entResponse" timeout="5" ignore-error="true">
                                    <set-url>@("{{entitlement-resolver-url}}" + "/entitlement/" + (string)context.Variables["userId"])</set-url>
                                    <set-method>GET</set-method>
                                    <authentication-managed-identity resource="{{entitlement-resolver-audience}}" />
                                </send-request>
                                </limit-concurrency>
                                <choose>
                                    <when condition="@(context.Variables.ContainsKey("entResponse") && ((IResponse)context.Variables["entResponse"]).StatusCode == 200)">
                                        <set-variable name="entRecord" value="@(((IResponse)context.Variables["entResponse"]).Body.As<string>(preserveContent: true))" />
                                        <cache-store-value key="@("ent:v2:{{tenant-id}}:" + (string)context.Variables["userId"])" value="@((string)context.Variables["entRecord"])" duration="@(int.Parse("{{entitlement-cache-seconds}}"))" />
                                    </when>
                                    <!-- 404 is the resolver's answer for an identity with no
                                         record: not entitled, the same as being in neither
                                         list. It is an answer, not a failure, so it becomes
                                         the ordinary 403 below.

                                         Before this branch existed a 404 fell through to the
                                         503 for an unreachable resolver. Measured on a live
                                         gateway 2026-09-23: an identity removed from the
                                         projection got 503 with Retry-After 5 and "this is not
                                         a problem with your access" - so every unentitled
                                         attempt read as an outage and invited a retry, and
                                         none of it was cached, so each retry reached the
                                         resolver again.

                                         Cached for at most a minute, and never longer than the
                                         configured window: long enough that a refused caller
                                         cannot hammer the resolver, short enough that someone
                                         just added to a group is let in promptly. -->
                                    <when condition="@(context.Variables.ContainsKey("entResponse") && ((IResponse)context.Variables["entResponse"]).StatusCode == 404)">
                                        <set-variable name="entRecord" value="@("{'tier':'none','businessUnit':''}")" />
                                        <cache-store-value key="@("ent:v2:{{tenant-id}}:" + (string)context.Variables["userId"])" value="@((string)context.Variables["entRecord"])" duration="@(Math.Min(60, int.Parse("{{entitlement-cache-seconds}}")))" />
                                    </when>
                                </choose>
                            </when>
                        </choose>
                        <set-variable name="entFresh" value="@{
                            if (!context.Variables.ContainsKey("entRecord")) { return false; }
                            var rec = JObject.Parse((string)context.Variables["entRecord"]);
                            if ((string)rec["tier"] == "none") { return true; }
                            // ADR-0051: projection records persist until a sync changes or removes them.
                            return !string.IsNullOrEmpty((string)rec["reconciliationGeneration"]);
                        }" />
                        <choose>
                            <when condition="@(context.Variables.ContainsKey("entRecord") && (bool)context.Variables["entFresh"])">
                                <set-variable name="tier" value="@{
                                    var rec = JObject.Parse((string)context.Variables["entRecord"]);
                                    var t = (string)rec["tier"];
                                    return (t == "premium" || t == "standard") ? t : "denied";
                                }" />
                                <set-variable name="businessUnit" value="@{
                                    var rec = JObject.Parse((string)context.Variables["entRecord"]);
                                    var u = (string)rec["businessUnit"];
                                    return string.IsNullOrEmpty(u) ? "unassigned" : u;
                                }" />
                                <set-variable name="entResolved" value="@(true)" />
                                <set-variable name="entResolving" value="@(false)" />
                            </when>
                            <otherwise>
                                <!-- The resolver did not answer, or the cached
                                     answer is not a usable projection record.
                                     
                                     ADR-0005 forbids treating this as
                                     user-not-found. A 403 would tell an entitled
                                     developer they have no access and send them
                                     to their platform team with the wrong
                                     problem. This is the gateway failing, not the
                                     developer, so it says so and answers 503 -
                                     which also puts it in availability metrics
                                     rather than hiding it in the normal 403
                                     rate. -->
                                <return-response>
                                    <set-status code="503" reason="Service Unavailable" />
                                    <set-header name="Content-Type" exists-action="override">
                                        <value>application/json</value>
                                    </set-header>
                                    <set-header name="Retry-After" exists-action="override">
                                        <value>5</value>
                                    </set-header>
                                    <set-body>@{
                                        return new JObject(
                                            new JProperty("type", "error"),
                                            new JProperty("error", new JObject(
                                                new JProperty("type", "api_error"),
                                                new JProperty("message",
                                                    "The entitlement projection has no usable answer, or the entitlement service did not answer. " +
                                                    "No usable entitlement answer is available. Your platform team must check the directory reconciliation " +
                                                    "and the entitlement service. Retry shortly.")))
                                        ).ToString();
                                    }</set-body>
                                </return-response>
                            </otherwise>
                        </choose>
                    </otherwise>
                </choose>
            </when>
        </choose>

        <!-- 3. Resolve the tier from Entra group membership. -->
        <choose>
            <when condition="@(!(bool)context.Variables["entResolved"])">
                <set-variable name="tier" value="@{
                    var oid = "," + (string)context.Variables["userId"] + ",";
                    if (("{{allow-premium}}").Contains(oid))  { return "premium"; }
                    if (("{{allow-standard}}").Contains(oid)) { return "standard"; }
                    return "denied";
                }" />
            </when>
        </choose>

        <!-- 4. Reject anyone not in a Claude Code group. -->
        <choose>
            <when condition="@((string)context.Variables["tier"] == "denied")">
                <return-response>
                    <set-status code="403" reason="Forbidden" />
                    <set-header name="Content-Type" exists-action="override">
                        <value>application/json</value>
                    </set-header>
                    <set-body>@{
                        return new JObject(
                            new JProperty("type", "error"),
                            new JProperty("error", new JObject(
                                new JProperty("type", "permission_error"),
                                new JProperty("message", "Not entitled to Claude Code. Ask your platform team to add you to the 'claude-code-standard' or 'claude-code-premium' Entra group.")
                            ))
                        ).ToString();
                    }</set-body>
                </return-response>
            </when>
        </choose>

        <!-- 5. Model allowlist, per tier.
             ==========================================================
             Checked here, before anything is forwarded, because this is the
             one capability control that can be enforced server-side. A model
             list delivered to a client is a preference: Anthropic's own
             guidance is that "a user who can run a modified Claude Code binary
             can bypass any client-side control". This one is not client-side.

             Sentinel commas make the match exact, so claude-opus-5 cannot
             match claude-opus-5-mini and a narrow list cannot be widened by a
             prefix.

             An empty list, ",,", allows every model. That is the shipped
             default: tiers differ by budget until an operator decides they
             should differ by model. -->
        <set-variable name="modelAllowed" value="@{
            var allowed = (string)context.Variables["tier"] == "premium"
                ? "{{models-premium}}" : "{{models-standard}}";
            if (allowed == null || allowed.Trim(',').Length == 0) { return true; }
            return allowed.Contains("," + (string)context.Variables["modelName"] + ",");
        }" />
        <choose>
            <when condition="@(!(bool)context.Variables["modelAllowed"])">
                <return-response>
                    <set-status code="403" reason="Forbidden" />
                    <set-header name="Content-Type" exists-action="override">
                        <value>application/json</value>
                    </set-header>
                    <set-body>@{
                        return new JObject(
                            new JProperty("type", "error"),
                            new JProperty("error", new JObject(
                                new JProperty("type", "invalid_request_error"),
                                new JProperty("code", "model_not_allowed"),
                                new JProperty("message", "The model '" + (string)context.Variables["modelName"] +
                                    "' is not available to the " + (string)context.Variables["tier"] +
                                    " tier. Your access is unaffected - choose a model your tier allows, or ask your platform team to widen the list.")
                            ))
                        ).ToString();
                    }</set-body>
                </return-response>
            </when>
        </choose>

        <!-- 5b. Optional Azure AI Content Safety request screening. -->
        <include-fragment fragment-id="content-safety-screening" />

        <!-- 6. Organisation-wide monthly ceiling.
             ==========================================================
             A constant counter-key is a single counter shared by every caller.
             Measured 2026-09-02 on a throwaway API: one caller drove the shared
             counter to zero and two callers who had spent nothing of their own
             quota were then refused. See docs/UNKNOWNS.md U1.

             This is a soft cap. The llm-token-limit reference states that
             high-concurrency requests can temporarily exceed the configured
             limit, so it bounds spend rather than guaranteeing it.

             It is also per gateway. The same reference states the policy tracks
             usage independently at each gateway and does not aggregate across
             the instance, so a multi-region deployment enforces this ceiling
             once per region. Basic v2 is single-region, so one gateway is one
             ceiling; on a multi-region Premium instance, budget accordingly.

             Checked before the per-tier budgets so that when the organisation is
             out of budget, that is what the developer is told.

             The budget variable names which ceiling is being checked. Both
             refusals are 403 with Reason=OpenAITokenQuotaExceeded, so on-error
             cannot tell them apart from context.LastError alone. Policies run in
             order and the failing one halts the pipeline, so the last value set
             here is the budget that refused. -->
        <set-variable name="budget" value="organisation" />
        <llm-token-limit
            counter-key="claude-org"
            token-quota="{{quota-org}}"
            token-quota-period="Monthly"
            estimate-prompt-tokens="false"
            remaining-quota-tokens-header-name="x-org-quota-remaining" />

        <!-- 6. Business unit, and its budget. ADR-0007.
             ==========================================================
             A business unit is an Entra group registered with a budget. The
             registry key is the stable identifier - it is what this counter,
             the ledger and every report use - while the group behind it can be
             renamed without orphaning the history.

             A developer in no business unit is "unassigned". What happens then
             is configurable and defaults to allow, because no developer has a
             business unit at the moment this first deploys and a default of deny
             would refuse every request on the deployment that installs it. The
             target state is deny; Get-ClaudeBusinessUnit.ps1 reports how many
             are still unassigned so that move is a decision with a number in
             front of it.

             Sentinel commas, so ",finance" cannot partially match
             ",finance-emea". Same convention as the entitlement lists. -->
        <choose>
            <when condition="@(!(bool)context.Variables["entResolved"])">
                <set-variable name="businessUnit" value="@{
                    var oid = (string)context.Variables["userId"];
                    var map = "{{bu-members}}";
                    var marker = "," + oid + "=";
                    var i = map.IndexOf(marker);
                    if (i < 0) { return "unassigned"; }
                    var start = i + marker.Length;
                    var end = map.IndexOf(",", start);
                    if (end < 0) { end = map.Length; }
                    return map.Substring(start, end - start);
                }" />
            </when>
        </choose>

        <choose>
            <when condition="@((string)context.Variables["businessUnit"] == "unassigned" && "{{bu-unassigned}}" == "deny")">
                <return-response>
                    <set-status code="403" reason="Forbidden" />
                    <set-header name="Content-Type" exists-action="override">
                        <value>application/json</value>
                    </set-header>
                    <set-body>@{
                        return new JObject(
                            new JProperty("type", "error"),
                            new JProperty("error", new JObject(
                                new JProperty("type", "permission_error"),
                                new JProperty("message", "You are not assigned to a business unit, so this request has no budget to charge. Ask your platform team to add you to a business unit group.")
                            ))
                        ).ToString();
                    }</set-body>
                </return-response>
            </when>
        </choose>

        <!-- The business unit's own monthly budget. Its quota comes from the
             registry, looked up by the same anchored scan.

             Zero means no budget is set for this unit, and the limit is skipped
             rather than refusing everything - an unpriced business unit should
             behave like the organisation ceiling alone, not like a wall. -->
        <set-variable name="buQuota" value="@{
            var bu = (string)context.Variables["businessUnit"];
            var reg = "{{bu-registry}}";
            var marker = "," + bu + "=";
            var i = reg.IndexOf(marker);
            if (i < 0) { return "0"; }
            var start = i + marker.Length;
            var end = reg.IndexOf(",", start);
            if (end < 0) { end = reg.Length; }
            var entry = reg.Substring(start, end - start);
            var colon = entry.LastIndexOf(":");
            if (colon < 0) { return "0"; }
            var tokens = entry.Substring(colon + 1);
            long parsed;
            return long.TryParse(tokens, out parsed) && parsed > 0 ? tokens : "0";
        }" />

        <set-variable name="buMode" value="@{
            var unit = (string)context.Variables["businessUnit"];
            var map = "{{bu-modes}}";
            var marker = "," + unit + "=";
            var i = map.IndexOf(marker);
            if (i < 0) { return "strict"; }
            var start = i + marker.Length;
            var end = map.IndexOf(",", start);
            if (end < 0) { return "strict"; }
            var mode = map.Substring(start, end - start);
            return System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex.IsMatch(mode, "^(notify|allowance:([1-9][0-9]?|100))$") ? mode : "strict";
        }" />
        <set-variable name="buLimit" value="@{
            var mode = (string)context.Variables["buMode"];
            if (mode == "notify") { return "0"; }
            if (mode.StartsWith("allowance:")) {
                var tokens = decimal.Parse((string)context.Variables["buQuota"]);
                var pct = int.Parse(mode.Substring(10));
                return ((long)Math.Min(long.MaxValue, tokens + Math.Floor(tokens * pct / 100m))).ToString();
            }
            return (string)context.Variables["buQuota"];
        }" />
        <choose>
            <when condition="@((string)context.Variables["buQuota"] != "0" && (string)context.Variables["buLimit"] != "0")">
                <set-variable name="budget" value="business unit" />
                <set-variable name="budgetUnit" value="@((string)context.Variables["businessUnit"])" />
                <llm-token-limit
                    counter-key="@("bu-" + (string)context.Variables["businessUnit"])"
                    token-quota="@(long.Parse((string)context.Variables["buLimit"]))"
                    token-quota-period="Monthly"
                    estimate-prompt-tokens="false"
                    remaining-quota-tokens-header-name="x-bu-quota-remaining"
                    remaining-quota-tokens-variable-name="buRemaining" />
            </when>
        </choose>

        <!-- 6b. The parent business unit, if this unit is a team. ADR-0008.
             ==========================================================
             A team is a unit that names a parent. The request is charged to the
             team and to the business unit above it - two counters, both monthly,
             both soft. A unit with no parent is charged once.

             The cascade is two levels because it is written here as two policy
             elements with statically written counter keys, and there is no loop.
             Set-ClaudeBusinessUnit.ps1 refuses a deeper chain when it is
             written, so a third level cannot silently go uncharged. -->
        <set-variable name="parentUnit" value="@{
            var unit = (string)context.Variables["businessUnit"];
            var parents = "{{bu-parents}}";
            var marker = "," + unit + "=";
            var i = parents.IndexOf(marker);
            if (i < 0) { return ""; }
            var start = i + marker.Length;
            var end = parents.IndexOf(",", start);
            if (end < 0) { end = parents.Length; }
            return parents.Substring(start, end - start);
        }" />

        <set-variable name="parentQuota" value="@{
            var parent = (string)context.Variables["parentUnit"];
            if (parent == "") { return "0"; }
            var reg = "{{bu-registry}}";
            var marker = "," + parent + "=";
            var i = reg.IndexOf(marker);
            if (i < 0) { return "0"; }
            var start = i + marker.Length;
            var end = reg.IndexOf(",", start);
            if (end < 0) { end = reg.Length; }
            var entry = reg.Substring(start, end - start);
            var colon = entry.LastIndexOf(":");
            if (colon < 0) { return "0"; }
            var tokens = entry.Substring(colon + 1);
            long parsed;
            return long.TryParse(tokens, out parsed) && parsed > 0 ? tokens : "0";
        }" />

        <set-variable name="parentMode" value="@{
            var unit = (string)context.Variables["parentUnit"];
            var map = "{{bu-modes}}";
            var marker = "," + unit + "=";
            var i = map.IndexOf(marker);
            if (i < 0) { return "strict"; }
            var start = i + marker.Length;
            var end = map.IndexOf(",", start);
            if (end < 0) { return "strict"; }
            var mode = map.Substring(start, end - start);
            return System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex.IsMatch(mode, "^(notify|allowance:([1-9][0-9]?|100))$") ? mode : "strict";
        }" />
        <set-variable name="parentLimit" value="@{
            var mode = (string)context.Variables["parentMode"];
            if (mode == "notify") { return "0"; }
            if (mode.StartsWith("allowance:")) {
                var tokens = decimal.Parse((string)context.Variables["parentQuota"]);
                var pct = int.Parse(mode.Substring(10));
                return ((long)Math.Min(long.MaxValue, tokens + Math.Floor(tokens * pct / 100m))).ToString();
            }
            return (string)context.Variables["parentQuota"];
        }" />
        <choose>
            <when condition="@((string)context.Variables["parentUnit"] != "" && (string)context.Variables["parentQuota"] != "0" && (string)context.Variables["parentLimit"] != "0")">
                <set-variable name="budget" value="business unit" />
                <set-variable name="budgetUnit" value="@((string)context.Variables["parentUnit"])" />
                <llm-token-limit
                    counter-key="@("bu-" + (string)context.Variables["parentUnit"])"
                    token-quota="@(long.Parse((string)context.Variables["parentLimit"]))"
                    token-quota-period="Monthly"
                    estimate-prompt-tokens="false"
                    remaining-quota-tokens-header-name="x-bu-parent-quota-remaining"
                    remaining-quota-tokens-variable-name="parentRemaining" />
            </when>
        </choose>

        <!-- Observed-category dollars are reconciled outside inference. ADR-0026.
             Base64 keeps JSON quotes out of policy string substitution. -->
        <set-variable name="usdDecision" value="@{
            try {
                var spec = JObject.Parse(System.Text.Encoding.UTF8.GetString(Convert.FromBase64String("{{usd-budgets}}")));
                if (!spec.HasValues) { return "{}"; }
                if ((int?)spec["schema_version"] != 1 || !(spec["items"] is JObject)) { throw new Exception("schema"); }
                var budgets = (JObject)spec["items"];
                var unit = (string)context.Variables["businessUnit"];
                var parent = (string)context.Variables["parentUnit"];
                var leafKey = (string.IsNullOrEmpty(parent) ? "organization:" : "department:") + unit;
                var keys = new string[] {
                    "user:" + (string)context.Variables["userId"],
                    leafKey,
                    "organization:" + parent
                };
                var notices = new JArray();
                var enforced = new System.Collections.Generic.List<string>();
                foreach (var key in keys) {
                    if (budgets[key] == null) { continue; }
                    var mode = key.StartsWith("user:") ? "strict"
                        : (string)context.Variables[key == leafKey ? "buMode" : "parentMode"];
                    if (mode == "notify") {
                        notices.Add(new JObject(new JProperty("scope", key), new JProperty("status", "usage-reported"),
                            new JProperty("budget_usd", budgets[key]["amount_usd"]),
                            new JProperty("spent_usd", null), new JProperty("exact", false)));
                    } else { enforced.Add(key); }
                }
                if (enforced.Count == 0) {
                    return new JObject(new JProperty("notices", notices)).ToString(Newtonsoft.Json.Formatting.None);
                }
                var state = JObject.Parse(System.Text.Encoding.UTF8.GetString(Convert.FromBase64String("{{usd-budget-state}}")));
                var material = string.Join("\n", new string[] { "{{usd-budgets}}", "{{bu-modes}}", "{{bu-parents}}", "{{bu-members}}", "{{entitlement-source}}" });
                var hash = BitConverter.ToString(System.Security.Cryptography.SHA256.Create().ComputeHash(System.Text.Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(material))).Replace("-", "").ToLowerInvariant();
                var now = DateTime.UtcNow;
                var asof = ((DateTimeOffset)state["reconciled_at"]).UtcDateTime;
                var until = ((DateTimeOffset)state["valid_until"]).UtcDateTime;
                if ((int?)state["schema_version"] != 1 || (string)state["policy_revision"] != hash ||
                    state["source_revision"] == null || now >= until || asof > now.AddSeconds(60) ||
                    until > asof.AddSeconds(900) || !(state["items"] is JObject)) { throw new Exception("stale"); }
                foreach (var key in enforced) {
                    var entry = state["items"][key];
                    var item = entry as JObject;
                    if (entry is JArray) {
                        var data = (JArray)entry;
                        if ((string)state["encoding"] != "compact-v1" || data.Count != 8) { throw new Exception("encoding"); }
                        var window = state["periods"][(string)data[0]] as JArray;
                        var flags = (int)data[6];
                        if (window == null || window.Count != 2 || flags < 0 || flags > 7) { throw new Exception("compact"); }
                        var split = key.Split(':');
                        item = new JObject(new JProperty("scope_type", split[0]), new JProperty("scope_id", split[1]),
                            new JProperty("period", data[0]), new JProperty("period_start", window[0]), new JProperty("period_end", window[1]),
                            new JProperty("price_book_date", state["price_book_date"]),
                            new JProperty("budget_usd", data[1]), new JProperty("effective_budget_usd", data[2]),
                            new JProperty("spent_usd", data[3]), new JProperty("status", data[4]), new JProperty("enforcement", data[5]),
                            new JProperty("exact", (flags & 1) != 0), new JProperty("cache_read_known", (flags & 2) != 0),
                            new JProperty("cache_write_known", (flags & 4) != 0), new JProperty("unpriced_models", data[7]));
                    }
                    if (item == null) { throw new Exception("missing"); }
                    var start = ((DateTimeOffset)item["period_start"]).UtcDateTime;
                    var end = ((DateTimeOffset)item["period_end"]).UtcDateTime;
                    if (now < start || now >= end) { throw new Exception("window"); }
                    var status = (string)item["status"];
                    if (status == "stop" || status == "unpriced") {
                        var error = (JObject)item.DeepClone();
                        error["code"] = status == "stop" ? "usd_budget_exceeded" : "usd_budget_unpriced";
                        error["type"] = "rate_limit_error";
                        error["reconciled_at"] = state["reconciled_at"].DeepClone();
                        error["http_status"] = 403;
                        error["message"] = status == "stop"
                            ? "The observed USD budget for this scope is spent. Ask its owner to raise it, then reconcile."
                            : "Usage cannot be completely priced for this scope. Ask the gateway owner to correct the dated price book.";
                        return error.ToString(Newtonsoft.Json.Formatting.None);
                    }
                    if (status == "notice") {
                        notices.Add(new JObject(new JProperty("scope", key), new JProperty("status", "observed-usage"),
                            new JProperty("spent_usd", item["spent_usd"]), new JProperty("budget_usd", item["budget_usd"]),
                            new JProperty("exact", item["exact"]), new JProperty("reconciled_at", state["reconciled_at"])));
                    } else if (status != "allow") { throw new Exception("decision"); }
                }
                return new JObject(new JProperty("notices", notices)).ToString(Newtonsoft.Json.Formatting.None);
            } catch {
                return new JObject(new JProperty("http_status", 503), new JProperty("type", "api_error"),
                    new JProperty("code", "usd_budget_state_stale"),
                    new JProperty("message", "USD budget state is missing, expired or does not match configuration. Reconcile budgets; token access has not been removed.")).ToString(Newtonsoft.Json.Formatting.None);
            }
        }" />
        <choose>
            <when condition="@(JObject.Parse((string)context.Variables["usdDecision"])["http_status"] != null)">
                <return-response>
                    <set-status code="@((int)JObject.Parse((string)context.Variables["usdDecision"])["http_status"])" reason="USD budget control" />
                    <set-header name="Content-Type" exists-action="override"><value>application/json</value></set-header>
                    <set-body>@(new JObject(new JProperty("type", "error"), new JProperty("error", JObject.Parse((string)context.Variables["usdDecision"]))).ToString())</set-body>
                </return-response>
            </when>
        </choose>

        <!-- 7. Per-minute rate, by tier. This stays a branch because
             tokens-per-minute is one of the attributes the llm-token-limit
             reference does not allow an expression for. Exceeding it returns
             429. -->
        <set-variable name="budget" value="personal" />
        <choose>
            <when condition="@((string)context.Variables["tier"] == "premium")">
                <llm-token-limit
                    counter-key="@((string)context.Variables["userId"])"
                    tokens-per-minute="{{tpm-premium}}"
                    estimate-prompt-tokens="false"
                    retry-after-header-name="Retry-After"
                    remaining-tokens-header-name="x-ratelimit-remaining-tokens"
                    tokens-consumed-header-name="x-tokens-consumed" />
            </when>
            <otherwise>
                <llm-token-limit
                    counter-key="@((string)context.Variables["userId"])"
                    tokens-per-minute="{{tpm-standard}}"
                    estimate-prompt-tokens="false"
                    retry-after-header-name="Retry-After"
                    remaining-tokens-header-name="x-ratelimit-remaining-tokens"
                    tokens-consumed-header-name="x-tokens-consumed" />
            </otherwise>
        </choose>

        <!-- 7b. Daily token budget, keyed on oid so one developer cannot starve
             the team. Exceeding it returns 403.

             quota-overrides gives one person a different daily budget without
             moving them between tiers. It is comma-delimited, not JSON: a named
             value substitutes its raw text into the expression, and JSON's own
             double quotes would terminate the surrounding C# string literal.
             Sentinel commas make the lookup exact, so one object id cannot
             partially match another - the same reason allow-standard uses them.

             Format: ,oid=tokens,oid=tokens,   Empty is ,,

             token-quota takes an expression, which is what allows one policy to
             serve both tiers and any override. Measured 2026-09-02: the
             expression must return long. Int32 is rejected at deploy time with
             "Expression return type 'System.Int32' is not allowed", and string
             with "Cannot implicitly convert type 'string' to 'long'". -->
        <set-variable name="effectiveQuota" value="@{
            var oid = (string)context.Variables["userId"];
            var tierQuota = (string)context.Variables["tier"] == "premium"
                ? "{{quota-premium}}" : "{{quota-standard}}";
            var map = "{{quota-overrides}}";
            var marker = "," + oid + "=";
            var i = map.IndexOf(marker);
            if (i < 0) { return tierQuota; }
            var start = i + marker.Length;
            var end = map.IndexOf(",", start);
            if (end < 0) { end = map.Length; }
            var found = map.Substring(start, end - start);
            long parsed;
            return long.TryParse(found, out parsed) && parsed > 0 ? found : tierQuota;
        }" />
        <llm-token-limit
            counter-key="@((string)context.Variables["userId"] + ":daily")"
            token-quota="@(long.Parse((string)context.Variables["effectiveQuota"]))"
            token-quota-period="Daily"
            estimate-prompt-tokens="false"
            remaining-quota-tokens-header-name="x-quota-remaining-today" />

        <!-- 8. Request-rate ceiling. Token budgets alone do not stop a runaway
             agent loop making many small calls. -->
        <rate-limit-by-key
            calls="{{calls-per-minute}}"
            renewal-period="60"
            counter-key="@((string)context.Variables["userId"])"
            retry-after-header-name="Retry-After" />

        <!-- 9. Chargeback telemetry to Application Insights, sliced by
             developer, tier, model and Claude Code session. Azure Monitor
             allows at most 5 custom dimensions here. -->
        <llm-emit-token-metric namespace="claudecode">
            <dimension name="User" value="@((string)context.Variables["userUpn"])" />
            <dimension name="UserId" value="@((string)context.Variables["userId"])" />
            <dimension name="Tier" value="@((string)context.Variables["tier"])" />
            <dimension name="Model" value="@((string)context.Variables["modelName"])" />
            <dimension name="SessionId" value="@((string)context.Variables["sessionId"])" />
        </llm-emit-token-metric>

        <!-- 10. Swap the caller's token for the gateway's own identity. The
             developer token is deliberately not forwarded: Foundry trusts only
             the gateway's managed identity. -->
        <authentication-managed-identity
            resource="https://cognitiveservices.azure.com"
            output-token-variable-name="msi-token"
            ignore-error="false" />
        <set-header name="Authorization" exists-action="override">
            <value>@("Bearer " + (string)context.Variables["msi-token"])</value>
        </set-header>
        <set-header name="x-api-key" exists-action="delete" />

        <!-- 11. Attribution for Foundry-side logs. -->
        <set-header name="x-gateway-user" exists-action="override">
            <value>@((string)context.Variables["userUpn"])</value>
        </set-header>
    </inbound>

    <backend>
        <!-- Agent turns are long, so allow generous time. -->
        <forward-request timeout="600" buffer-request-body="false" buffer-response="false" />
    </backend>

    <outbound>
        <base />
        <set-variable name="usdUsageJson" value="unknown" />
        <choose>
            <when condition="@(!(bool)context.Variables["usdRequestStream"] && context.Response.StatusCode == 200 && context.Request.Url.Path.EndsWith("/messages") && context.Response.Headers.GetValueOrDefault("Content-Type", "").Contains("application/json"))">
                <set-variable name="usdUsageJson" value="@{
                    try {
                        var body = context.Response.Body.As<JObject>(preserveContent: true);
                        var usage = body["usage"] as JObject;
                        if (usage == null) { return "unknown"; }
                        var counts = new JObject();
                        foreach (var name in new string[] { "input_tokens", "output_tokens", "cache_read_input_tokens", "cache_creation_input_tokens", "cache_creation", "inference_geo" }) {
                            if (usage[name] != null) { counts[name] = usage[name].DeepClone(); }
                        }
                        var text = counts.ToString(Newtonsoft.Json.Formatting.None);
                        return text.Length <= 1024 ? text : "unknown";
                    } catch { return "unknown"; }
                }" />
            </when>
        </choose>
        <choose>
            <when condition="@(JObject.Parse((string)context.Variables["usdDecision"])["notices"] is JArray && ((JArray)JObject.Parse((string)context.Variables["usdDecision"])["notices"]).Count > 0)">
                <set-header name="x-claude-usd-budget-notice" exists-action="override">
                    <value>@(JObject.Parse((string)context.Variables["usdDecision"])["notices"].ToString(Newtonsoft.Json.Formatting.None))</value>
                </set-header>
            </when>
        </choose>

        <!-- Remaining quota is an estimate, not a monthly ledger (ADR-0019).
             Notify has no limiter and therefore no remaining counter. Its
             advisory is present before and after the base budget is reached. -->
        <set-variable name="budgetNotice" value="@{
            var notices = new System.Collections.Generic.List<string>();
            foreach (var scope in new string[] { "bu", "parent" }) {
                var budget = long.Parse((string)context.Variables[scope + "Quota"]);
                if (budget == 0) { continue; }
                var mode = (string)context.Variables[scope + "Mode"];
                var unit = (string)context.Variables[scope == "bu" ? "businessUnit" : "parentUnit"];
                if (mode == "notify") {
                    notices.Add(unit + ";mode=notify;status=usage-reported");
                } else if (mode.StartsWith("allowance:") && context.Variables.ContainsKey(scope + "Remaining")) {
                    var limit = long.Parse((string)context.Variables[scope + "Limit"]);
                    var remaining = Convert.ToInt64(context.Variables[scope + "Remaining"]);
                    if (remaining < limit - budget) { notices.Add(unit + ";mode=" + mode + ";status=estimated-over-budget"); }
                }
            }
            return string.Join(", ", notices);
        }" />
        <choose>
            <when condition="@((string)context.Variables["budgetNotice"] != "")">
                <set-header name="x-claude-budget-notice" exists-action="override">
                    <value>@((string)context.Variables["budgetNotice"])</value>
                </set-header>
            </when>
        </choose>
        <!-- The chargeback ledger's identity half. ADR-0006.
             ==========================================================
             The per-request token record is ApiManagementGatewayLlmLog, which
             is a log rather than a metric, so it has no cardinality cap and
             does not silently discard data past a hundred developers. What it
             does not have is a caller: its columns are tokens, model and ids.

             This supplies the caller, keyed on context.RequestId so the two can
             be joined. The key is carried deliberately rather than inferred:
             the log's CorrelationId is a GUID, and Application Insights
             operation_Id is a W3C trace id, so they do not match.

             A trace is used rather than a metric dimension because the trace
             policy is documented as not affected by Application Insights
             sampling - every invocation is logged, which is what a billing
             record needs.

             UsageJson is counts only, collected above for nonstream JSON.
             Streaming bodies are never read. Their per-request cache remains
             unknown rather than zero; this is not complete streaming billing. -->
        <trace source="claude-chargeback" severity="information">
            <message>@("chargeback " + (string)context.Variables["userUpn"])</message>
            <metadata name="RequestId" value="@(context.RequestId.ToString())" />
            <metadata name="UserId" value="@((string)context.Variables["userId"])" />
            <metadata name="User" value="@((string)context.Variables["userUpn"])" />
            <metadata name="Tier" value="@((string)context.Variables["tier"])" />
            <metadata name="BusinessUnit" value="@((string)context.Variables["businessUnit"])" />
            <metadata name="Model" value="@((string)context.Variables["modelName"])" />
            <metadata name="UsageJson" value="@((string)context.Variables["usdUsageJson"])" />
            <metadata name="ClientIp" value="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<string>("claude-edge-client-ip", context.Request.IpAddress))" />
            <!-- Which client made the call. Captured raw and truncated rather
                 than classified here: a classifier in policy needs a redeploy
                 every time a client changes its agent string, where the same
                 rule in KQL is a query edit. Truncated because a user agent has
                 no length limit and this is one field on every request.

                 Nothing else in APIM carries it - measured 2026-09-16,
                 AppRequests.Properties holds only API and service metadata,
                 ClientType reads "PC" and ClientBrowser is empty. -->
            <metadata name="Client" value="@{
                var ua = context.Request.Headers.GetValueOrDefault("User-Agent", "");
                if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(ua)) { return "unknown"; }
                return ua.Length > 120 ? ua.Substring(0, 120) : ua;
            }" />
        </trace>

        <choose>
            <when condition="@((string)context.Variables["buMode"] != "strict" || (string)context.Variables["parentMode"] != "strict")">
                <trace source="claude-budget" severity="information">
                    <message>Budget mode usage; join BudgetRequestId to the usage ledger for monthly totals.</message>
                    <metadata name="BudgetRequestId" value="@(context.RequestId.ToString())" />
                    <metadata name="BusinessUnit" value="@((string)context.Variables["businessUnit"])" />
                    <metadata name="Mode" value="@((string)context.Variables["buMode"])" />
                    <metadata name="BaseTokens" value="@((string)context.Variables["buQuota"])" />
                    <!-- Trace metadata requires a non-empty value even when this scope has no parent or notice. -->
                    <metadata name="ParentUnit" value="@(string.IsNullOrEmpty((string)context.Variables["parentUnit"]) ? "none" : (string)context.Variables["parentUnit"])" />
                    <metadata name="ParentMode" value="@((string)context.Variables["parentMode"])" />
                    <metadata name="ParentBaseTokens" value="@((string)context.Variables["parentQuota"])" />
                    <metadata name="Notice" value="@(string.IsNullOrEmpty((string)context.Variables["budgetNotice"]) ? "none" : (string)context.Variables["budgetNotice"])" />
                </trace>
            </when>
        </choose>

        <set-header name="x-governed-by" exists-action="override">
            <value>apim-claude-gateway</value>
        </set-header>
        <set-header name="x-claude-gateway-request-id" exists-action="override">
            <value>@(context.RequestId.ToString())</value>
        </set-header>
        <set-header name="x-claude-tier" exists-action="override">
            <value>@((string)context.Variables["tier"])</value>
        </set-header>
    </outbound>

    <on-error>
        <base />
        <set-header name="x-gateway-error" exists-action="override">
            <value>@(context.LastError?.Reason ?? "unknown")</value>
        </set-header>

        <!-- A budget refusal and an entitlement refusal are both 403, so without
             this a developer who has simply run out of budget reads it as losing
             access and raises a ticket.

             Measured 2026-09-02: llm-token-limit raises
             Reason=OpenAITokenQuotaExceeded, Source=llm-token-limit, Scope=api,
             and its own body is {"statusCode":403,"message":"Token quota is
             exceeded..."} - not Anthropic's error shape, so the client shows it
             raw. This replaces it with the shape Claude Code expects and names
             which budget ran out. -->
        <choose>
            <when condition="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<bool>("entResolving", false) && (context.LastError.Source == "rate-limit-by-key" || context.LastError.Source == "limit-concurrency"))">
                <return-response>
                    <set-status code="429" reason="Too Many Requests" />
                    <set-header name="Content-Type" exists-action="override"><value>application/json</value></set-header>
                    <set-header name="Retry-After" exists-action="override"><value>1</value></set-header>
                    <set-body>{"type":"error","error":{"type":"rate_limit_error","message":"Entitlement lookup is busy. Retry shortly; your access has not changed."}}</set-body>
                </return-response>
            </when>
            <when condition="@(context.Variables.ContainsKey("entResolving") && (bool)context.Variables["entResolving"])">
                <!-- Anything that threw while resolving entitlement from the
                     projection. send-request's ignore-error covers a transport
                     failure, but a managed-identity token failure throws out of
                     the whole block and would otherwise reach the developer as
                     an unexplained 500.
                     
                     Answered here as 503 for the same reason as the inline path:
                     this is the gateway failing, not the developer, and it must
                     not read as a loss of access. -->
                <return-response>
                    <set-status code="503" reason="Service Unavailable" />
                    <set-header name="Content-Type" exists-action="override">
                        <value>application/json</value>
                    </set-header>
                    <set-header name="Retry-After" exists-action="override">
                        <value>5</value>
                    </set-header>
                    <set-body>@{
                        return new JObject(
                            new JProperty("type", "error"),
                            new JProperty("error", new JObject(
                                new JProperty("type", "api_error"),
                                new JProperty("message",
                                    "The entitlement service could not be reached: " +
                                    (context.LastError?.Reason ?? "unknown") +
                                    ". This is not a problem with your access. Retry shortly.")))
                        ).ToString();
                    }</set-body>
                </return-response>
            </when>
        </choose>

        <choose>
            <when condition="@(context.LastError?.Reason == "OpenAITokenQuotaExceeded")">
                <return-response>
                    <set-status code="403" reason="Forbidden" />
                    <set-header name="Content-Type" exists-action="override">
                        <value>application/json</value>
                    </set-header>
                    <set-body>@{
                        var which = (string)(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("budget", "personal"));
                        var msg = which == "organisation"
                            ? "The organisation's Claude budget for this period is spent. Your access is unaffected - this limit is shared, so it applies to everyone until the budget resets or your platform team raises quota-org."
                            : which == "business unit"
                                ? "The Claude budget for your business unit (" + (string)(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("budgetUnit", "unknown")) + ") is spent for this period. Your access is unaffected - this budget is shared with your colleagues in that unit, and your platform team can raise it."
                                : "Your Claude budget for this period is spent. Your access is unaffected; the budget resets at the start of the next period. Ask your platform team if you need a larger tier.";
                        return new JObject(
                            new JProperty("type", "error"),
                            new JProperty("error", new JObject(
                                new JProperty("type", "rate_limit_error"),
                                new JProperty("budget", which),
                                new JProperty("message", msg)
                            ))
                        ).ToString();
                    }</set-body>
                </return-response>
            </when>
        </choose>
    </on-error>
</policies>
